action.objective: Verify the reserved suggestion a4c5 with a single-candidate deep search to qualify it for commit.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave a4c5 the best exact score (-118), but coverage is shallow and no move is commit-ready. The reserved verification budget of 2000 nodes is available for a4c5. A single-candidate verification at max_depth 4 will produce the exact evidence needed to qualify or refute it before committing.
